data.text: Seven decisions recorded from CLAUDE.md: DEC-38 conflicts surfaced, DEC-39 synchronous core with zero dependencies, DEC-40 the 200 ms budget and the lazy TUI, DEC-41 the board calls the CLI's functions, DEC-43 state.json never in git, DEC-44 append-only (replacing DEC-37), DEC-45 never commit for the user (replacing DEC-42). 'why are events append-only' now finds DEC-44 first; before, the top three were a migration task and two canvases. Golden set after the additions: see the relevance test output in this session. Left out on purpose: 'fully offline, no telemetry' and the invariants I1/I2/I7 - CLAUDE.md states them as rules without a reason, and the invariants already live in DOC-20.
